Chapter 349: Chapter 10: Command The Demon Beast Kings Of The Ten Great Mountains With My Decree (Happy New Year)

Chapter 349: Chapter 10: Command the Demon Beast Kings of the Ten Great Mountains with My Decree (Happy New Year)

“`

Decades ago,

the Tianqing Alliance Leader had already faintly perceived the “weakness” of the Ancestral Demon Tree.

But at that time, he wasn’t certain and couldn’t confirm if the so-called “weakness” was intentionally revealed by the Ancestral Demon Tree.

It might have been a ploy to lure him into a trap.

Wielding the World Sword, the Tianqing Alliance Leader was nearly invincible.

...

However, the precondition was that he could not stray too far from Tianqing World, as beyond a certain range, the power of the World Sword would be diminished.

If the Ancestral Demon Tree had such intentions, the Tianqing Alliance Leader naturally needed to be vigilant.

It was just now, in the midst of battle with the Ancestral Demon Tree within the Demon World, and with the help of the World Sword’s senses,

the Tianqing Alliance Leader truly felt the Ancestral Demon Tree’s weakness.

In the midst of a fierce battle, and with the World Sword’s perception, the Tianqing Alliance Leader confirmed his judgement.

“My fellow cultivators, our chance in Tianqing World has come,”

the Tianqing Alliance Leader said with a relieved breath, looking towards the twelve Vice Alliance Hierarchs with a serious expression.

“Opportunity?”

“What opportunity?”

“Alliance Leader, do you know something?”

The twelve Vice Alliance Hierarchs were originally somewhat anxious, but upon seeing the Alliance Leader’s expression and tone of voice, they immediately became curious.

“The Ancestral Demon Tree…”

The Tianqing Alliance Leader immediately shared his judgement.

“For over three hundred years, the Foreign Evil God used its mighty power to forcibly open a battlefield outside our Tianqing World, dragging us into an endless war mire…”

“Every moment, the strong of our Tianqing World die, but with the Evil God lying in wait, we have had no opportunity to destroy that battlefield.”

The Tianqing Alliance Leader spoke in a somber tone, as did the twelve Vice Alliance Hierarchs.

Over three hundred years of war had taken their friends, relatives, offspring, many of whom had been lost to the Evil God Puppets on the battlefield.

And as long as that battlefield existed, the war could not be stopped.

They indeed wanted to destroy the battlefield, so the Foreign Evil God would lose the basis to initiate it, but the Ancestral Demon Tree was too powerful.

Even if the Tianqing Alliance Leader joined forces with the twelve Vice Alliance Hierarchs, they could only manage to hold their own against the Ancestral Demon Tree at best.

But now,

the Ancestral Demon Tree was inexplicably weak, and the Tianqing Alliance Leader even had the confidence to contend with the adversary by himself.

As such, there was the possibility to destroy the battlefield and end the war.

As for the Ancestral Demon Tree? The Tianqing Alliance Leader had no intention to kill it – that was not realistic – but simply planned to drive it away.

“But now,”

“the opportunity has come, an opportunity to completely end the war has come,”

the Tianqing Alliance Leader stated emphatically, looking at the twelve Vice Alliance Hierarchs, pausing after each word.

“End the war?”

The hearts of the twelve Vice Alliance Hierarchs were ablaze.

They had dreamed of ending the war, but after three hundred years, hope always seemed out of sight.

Having heard the Alliance Leader’s words today, their hearts were beyond stirred.

“Going forward, I will use all our remaining resources to launch a counterattack,” the Tianqing Alliance Leader said, “If that Evil God dares to intervene, leave it to me.”

“All you need to do is secure the entire battlefield and then destroy it.”

“Yes,” the twelve Vice Alliance Hierarchs replied without hesitation.

The Evil God Battlefield was situated outside the World, and that was likely the Evil God’s lair and stronghold.

If that Evil God Battlefield were destroyed, the Ancestral Demon Tree would only be able to attack Tianqing World relying on its own strength, which would be virtually impossible.

And with the Ancestral Demon Tree’s current strength, under the targeted defense of the powerful in Tianqing World, it would not be able to open up a second battlefield.

In theory, as long as the Evil God Battlefield was destroyed, the Ancestral Demon Tree would no longer have the capability to come into Tianqing World.

…

“Issue my decree, order the ten mountain range Demon Beast Kings to the battlefield, ready for a counterattack,”

the Tianqing Alliance Leader instructed.

When the Ancestral Demon Tree invaded, the whole Tianqing World mobilized to resist.

But actually, before the battle began, the Tianqing Alliance Leader among others, made the worst assumption.

That was the inability to resist the Ancestral Demon Tree’s invasion, the collapse of the frontal battlefield.

The war situation would spread within the World.

For this reason, the Tianqing Alliance Leader, despite facing the most adverse Warfield conditions, never summoned the ten mountain range Demon Beast Kings.

The ten mountain range Demon Beast Kings were Tianqing World’s last resort to prevent a war collapse and invasion by Evil God Puppets.

In that eventuality, the ten mountain range Demon Beast Kings were to take action, replacing the defeated cultivator army to temporarily resist the Evil God Puppets’ invasion.

This was something the Tianqing Alliance Leader and the ten mountain range Demon Beast Kings had agreed upon many years ago when forming their covenant.

In a crucial moment, the ten mountain range Demon Beast Kings must heed the Tianqing Alliance Leader’s decree.

Of course,

the situation on the battlefield is ever-changing.

The ten mountain range Demon Beast Kings were originally the Tianqing Alliance Leader’s final force for resistance.

But now, the Tianqing Alliance Leader wished to gather all forces for a counterattack, which naturally meant the plans had to change a bit.

The Demon Beast Kings, after all, represented a significant force that could serve as the spearhead for a counterattack.

If the counterattack went smoothly and the Evil God was repelled, everything would be worth it.

“Yes.”

“Yes.”

“Yes.”

The twelve Vice Alliance Hierarchs replied spiritedly, turning to depart and convey the Tianqing Alliance Leader’s orders.

Besides the Demon Beast Kings, Tianqing World also harbored many hidden forces, all of which required the twelve Vice Alliance Hierarchs to authorize and command.
